mmaths-2023-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Let $n=p_1^{e_1}p_2^{e_2}\cdots p_k^{e_k}=\prod_{i=1}^k p_i^{e_i}$, where $p_1<p_2<\dots<p_k$ are primes and $e_1,e_2,\dots,e_k$ are positive integers, and let $f(n)=\prod_{i=1}^k e_i^{p_i}$. Find the number of integers $n$ such that $2\le n\le2023$ and $f(n)=128$.

mmaths-2023-tiebreaker-02.prompt: The lengths of the altitudes of $\triangle ABC$ are the roots of the polynomial $x^3-34x^2+360x-1200$. Find the area of $\triangle ABC$.
